sloka: इति संवदतोरेवमन्योन्यं नरसिंहयो: ।आगम्य प्राञ्जलि: काले गुहो भरतमब्रवीत् ।। २.८९.४ ।।
transliteration: iti saṁvadatorevamanyonyaṁ narasiṁhayo: ।āgamya prāñjali: kāle guho bharatamabravīt ।। 2.89.4 ।।

translations.english: While the two lions among men, Bharata and Satrughna were thus conversing with each other, Guha came in the appropriate time and said to Bharata with folded palms:
